Name: (CP and AT) Northwoods Buildings - Soren's Tanga Forest Buildings Edit
Author: nordkyst
Description:
[left]Northwoods Buildings is an edit / recolor of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16852?tab=description]Tanga Forest Buildings[/url]﻿ inspired by the colors of cabins and lodges in northern Minnesota. All of the buildings in the original Tanga Forest Buildings are included. It also uses a few vanilla assets edited by me. At this time, all code is original to the Tanga Forest Buildings mod. Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TangaS2/about-me?gameId=1303]Tanga[/url] for your amazing work and allowing others to use it as well.
[b][u][size=4]
Update log:[/size][/u]
[/b]
[list]
[*]6/17/24 -- v1.0.1 -- improved greenery for Barn, Big Barn, Deluxe Barn, Coop, Big Coop, & Deluxe Coop in all seasons.
[*]7/28/24 -- v1.1.0 -- added Alternative Textures version! Woohoo! Please report any issues to the comments or my Nexus messages.
[/list]

[b][u][size=4]Planned updates:[/size][/u]
[/b]

[*]Edit other buildings' windows/doors to match the house better
[*]Edit the colors on the seasonal leaves and vines to be brighter, like the original Tanga Forest Buildings and the farmhouse.
[*]Add shipping bin and some other misc items.
[*][s]Make an Alternative Textures version.[/s] We did it Reddit
